description: A shell script utility 'clawlog' to access and filter logs from the 'ai.openclaw' subsystem on macOS. It provides options for real-time streaming, filtering by category, severity, search text, and exporting logs, tailored to the VibeTunnel project for managing its logs via the unified logging system.

methods.name: handle_sudo_error
methods.description: Displays an instructional error message when sudo privileges are required.

methods.name: show_usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and command options for the 'clawlog' utility.

methods.name: list_categories
methods.description: Fetches and displays recent log categories from the 'ai.openclaw' subsystem.

methods.name: escape_predicate_literal
methods.description: Escapes special characters in predicate string literals for safe log filtering.
